$comment: Claim and status rules checked by `node tools/accuracy-sync.mjs --check` (npm run accuracy:check) next to docs/accuracy-figures.json. overclaims: a class of wording that claims more than was measured, banned in every user-facing page, nav.js, the en / zh dictionaries and the one-pagers (Fortune content excluded: entertainment, with its own bans). mustSay: the Thai text of every element with data-i18n=key in the listed pages, and the en / zh dictionary value, must contain each token. files: a regex that must (or, with "not": true, must not) match a file. Added in the Sellable pack (2026-11-11): hall mode and Crowd labels consistent everywhere, and no page claims more than was measured. Stream G (2026-11-13): no 'free, every feature' wording; the free tiers and the 30-day notice must be stated (ft.notice, pr.free). Owner decision 223 (2026-11-21, audit section 6 item 20): customer badges are now "รุ่นทดลอง" / "Trial version" / "试用版" (hall: "รุ่นทดลอง ยังไม่เปิดขาย"); Crowd says events + not for dense crowds and never "เบื้องต้น" (rules crowd-page*, crowd-no-prelim-*); the category card limit line is ln.crowd.2 (key cat.r.crowd is gone); the exam owner sentence (ln.exam.2) is on exam.html, exam-dashboard.html and the exam one-pager; the examinee page never mentions the desk.
